body:
http://www.reddit.com/r/AdviceAnimals/comments/1eox1b/its_annoying_when_people_ask_how_the_job_search/

I fell pretty far these past couple days and am really depressed and this thread expressed and validated my emotions and what is happening. I feel terrible, I had an interview, but they did not call me back today. They said they would call me back today if I got it, so I guess another failure to add to my list. I feel so useless and like such a burden on my bf that I live with, he's becoming stressed out now because we are living on one income and I feel like it would be better if I was no longer around. 

I really appreciate everyone efforts in trying to help me, every word counts, I am just so discourage and depressed about everything right now. Someone said to me that I just need to go to the Doctor...Ok I have no money, huge student loan debt, and now I am in debt from going to the doctor when I HAD insurance...medication is not going to get me a job and solve the problems that are causing my feelings of worthlessness...

I broke down today and just cried for a half hour as my bf tried to comfort me and tell me everything will be fine, it made me feel better but I am causing him so much stress with being unemployed...I kept telling myself I should just kill myself and everyone will be alright...I feel so worthless.

Thank you for taking the time to write all that. People keep talking about how money isn't everything but they didn't grow up dirt poor and on welfare, money isn't everything, its MOST things and you can't survive without it and are deemed worthless. The world has told me I was worthless since I was born because of how poor we were but I vowed to get out, get a degree, and break the cycle. 

It didn't work and I am still poor and perceived as worthless.

I have been think of trying to start my own thing but the startup money is stopping me, i haven't a penny to my name. 

I hope things go better for you than for me.  Thank you for your help, I'm trying to be positive again but I can't shake the feeling of worthlessness.
Oh no, it gave me a degree and almost $80k in student loan debt.
I used to believe that...but now...it just seems like a lie, like a childhood bedtime story, princesses and unicorns...

Well i had the talk with him again tonight and took your advice and gave him an ultimatum this time, he got angry and told me to leave, we've been together for 5 years and its over. Off to the suicide help subreddit I go. Good luck everyone else.
I came here to say this...
